text:
deploy-bot: deploy completed: release/2026.03.17 wave-3 -> canary (10%)
ajay-oncall: noticed canary latency jump ~09:40 UTC, p50 ~3x, p99 spiking. paging in case it's roll-related.
maria-dev: looking now — logs show a bunch of kernel_selector fallbacks and batching window collapse. suspect new kernel affinity change in this rollout. sample log: ```kernel_selector: fallback_to_generic_kernel reason=quant_mismatch model=redwood-v2 seq_len=256 host=gpu-12```
kevin-runtime: confirmed — kernel affinity heuristic triggered because quant route reported mismatch for some layer shapes. fallback path is slower and disables continuous batching (window shrank to 1).
lucy-support: Notes from CS: two paying customers (AcmeAnalytics, DBX) reported higher latencies and some timeouts. DBX seeing 12% errors.
ajay-oncall: paging eng-runtime and SRE. creating incident and assigning. @sre-bot created PD alert: INC-5543.
sre-bot: PagerDuty incident INC-5543 created, severity=P2, oncall=@sophie-oncall.
maria-dev: immediate mitigation options: 1) flip feature flag to stop wave rollout (kill-switch) 2) route canary traffic to legacy kernel selector 3) rollback release. recommend kill-switch + routing as fastest.
ajay-oncall: agree, do kill-switch first. maria - can you flip ff/rollout/wave-3 to false? I'll coordinate rollback if needed.
maria-dev: flipping flag now: ```curl -X POST https://ff.redwood.internal/api/flags/rollout/wave-3 -d '{"enabled":false}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN"```
maria-dev: flag flipped :white_check_mark: traffic stop initiated, will propagate in ~30s.
deploy-bot: observed config change: ff/rollout/wave-3=false. Canary traffic draining.
kevin-runtime: also applying route tweak to push existing canary pods to legacy-kernel pool to re-enable continuous batching: ```rlsctl route set --selector wave=wave-3 --kernel=legacy-affinity```
kevin-runtime: route change applied. batching windows recovering on a few hosts. p50 trending down.
lucy-support: DBX error rate dropping now (observed ~6% -> 1.5%). customer notified via status page update.
ajay-oncall: good. start graceful rollback of any remaining canary instances to v2026.03.16 to be safe. maria/deploy-bot coordinate.
maria-dev: initiating rollback: ```deployctl rollback --release release/2026.03.16 --scope canary-wave-3 --now```
deploy-bot: rollback started for scope=canary-wave-3.
kevin-runtime: monitoring for kernel fallback logs — they dropped significantly after route change. batching windows back to normal on ~80% of canary hosts.
sophie-oncall: ack, taking over monitoring. will watch until metrics stable for 30m. handing off from @ajay-oncall.
ajay-oncall: handing off to @sophie-oncall — I need to jump to regulatory call but will be available.
sophie-oncall: ack, I have alerts and dashboards open. ping me if anything re-escalates.
maria-dev: post-rollback immediate action items: file bug for kernel_selector heuristics, add unit test for quant-path mapping, add Canary gating to require kernel selector sanity check before traffic shift.
kevin-runtime: will open PR to short-circuit fallback path to keep batching alive while we fix heuristics.
lucy-support: CS will follow up with impacted customers and offer incident summary.
ajay-oncall: initial customer-impact note for postmortem: "~15% of canary traffic experienced elevated latency; two customers saw errors/timeouts; mitigated by feature-flag kill-switch, routing to legacy kernel pool, and rollback."
sophie-oncall: monitoring 15m and 30m windows — p50/p90/p99 all trending to baseline. will close incident if stable at 30m.
maria-dev: thanks everyone. will draft postmortem and timeline. assigning follow-ups in the ticket. :white_check_mark:
